instruction: Run `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\rlc_bp.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\rlc_bp.out`, `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\rlc_bp_measure.txt`, and `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\rlc_bp.dat`. Then read the sampled dB measurements from `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\rlc_bp_measure.txt` and write `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\metrics.json` with `f0`, `Q`, and `BW_3dB`, where `f0` is the peak sample frequency and `BW_3dB` is the sample-grid width between the lowest and highest frequencies that stay within 3 dB of that peak.
